texts.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
texts.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system will one day become a stalwart panopticon, our eye on every star.

tooltips.zh: 哨兵阵列基址现已就位，但在上线运行前尚需进一步建造。
tooltips.en: The Sentry Array Site is in place, awaiting further development before it can be brought online.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Sentry hub built (spy_orb_1)

notes.zh: 审阅说明：哨兵阵列每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Sentry Array fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order.

texts.zh:
哨兵阵列中心本身就代表着目前的最高技术水平，其将监听站和太空望远镜合二为一。

但这只是这一伟大工程的第一块里程碑。
texts.en:
The hub of the Sentry Array is a state-of-the-art installation in its own right, half listening post and half space telescope.

However, it marks but the first milestone in this grand undertaking.

tooltips.zh: 哨兵中心已上线运行。我们的传感器探测范围提升了。
tooltips.en: Sentry Hub online. Our sensor range has been increased.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Sentry Array completed (spy_orb_4)

label.zh: 中心建成时：有通讯并有情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件4101）
label.en: When the hub is built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 4101)

texts.zh:
被封装在围绕在哨兵阵列上的环中的科技应该被严加看管以防泄密。

不过它带来的效果毋庸置疑，我们现在几乎能完全掌控整个星系所有舰队的动向。
texts.en:
Exactly what technology is housed in the ring that encircles the Sentry Array is a closely guarded secret.

The results, however, are undeniable. We now have virtually perfect knowledge of all fleet movements in the galaxy.

tooltips.zh: 传感范围激活至星系级。

label.zh: 完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知
label.en: On completion: the same empires get a notice

texts.zh:
我们收到消息，[From.GetName]已经完成了位于[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的哨兵阵列的建造。

我们认为他们已经能完全掌握关于我方舰队位置和组成的情报。
texts.en:
We have received word that the [From.GetName] have completed their Sentry Array in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system.

We should assume that they now have virtually perfect intel pertaining to the location and make-up of our fleets.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息，[From.GetName]开始在[spy_system.GetName]星系建造一个庞大，长程传感阵列。虽然还在早期阶段，完全完成的阵列将提供给他们全星系完全的星际活动动向。
texts.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has begun the construction of a vast, long-range sensor array in the [spy_system.GetName] system. While still in its early stages, the completed array is set to give them unfettered insight into interstellar travel in this galaxy.

texts.zh:
在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。

残骸中以一个庞大的哨兵阵列为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
texts.en:
At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits around most of the planetary bodies in this system, including several massive space station hulks.

The largest of these is a colossal Sentry Array. Our initial scans suggest that when it was operational, this array was powerful enough to provide real-time sensor coverage over the entire galaxy.

label.zh: 我们已经有哨兵阵列了。
label.en: We already have one of those.

label.zh: 修复废墟（建造“修复”型巨型结构）后
label.en: After the ruin is restored (the "restored" megastructure type is built over it)

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

texts.zh:
虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。

时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
texts.en:
It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.

For the first time in eons, the array now hums with energy. Its powerful antennas can once again see clear to the other side of the galaxy.

summary.text:
# 哨兵阵列 / Sentry Array

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/02_spy_orb.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Utopia（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工哨兵阵列（见 common/megastructures/02_spy_orb.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Sentry Array inside your borders (common/megastructures/02_spy_orb.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. utopia.4100：哨兵阵列基址建成（spy_orb_0） / Sentry Array site built (spy_orb_0)
2. utopia.4103：哨兵中心建成（spy_orb_1） / Sentry hub built (spy_orb_1)
3. utopia.4104：哨兵阵列完工（spy_orb_4） / Sentry Array completed (spy_orb_4)

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- utopia.4102：中心建成时：有通讯并有情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件4101） / When the hub is built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 4101)
- utopia.4110：完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知 / On completion: the same empires get a notice
- 废墟 The ruin：utopia.2014（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_sentry_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；utopia.2015 在修复完成后出现。
  utopia.2014 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). utopia.2015 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.


## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/02_spy_orb.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
